# CG-AUTH-003: Authentication relaxed

Every baseline credential still works and more are accepted.

**Why it matters:** More accepted credentials widen accepted requests.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Security](./#auth) |
| Detects | `security.alternativesChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Authentication of {operation} was relaxed.
>
> Existing consumers keep working.
>
> **Fix:** Review the security implications of relaxed authentication.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: anonymous access allowed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- security: [{key: []}]
+ security: [{key: []}, {}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Authentication of GET /x was relaxed.

### Fires: alternative added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- security: [{key: []}]
+ security: [{key: []}, {bearer: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
      bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Authentication of GET /x was relaxed.

### Does not fire: alternative removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- security: [{key: []}, {bearer: []}]
+ security: [{key: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
      bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml

  ignore:
    - rule: CG-AUTH-003
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:

```
